```{r}
#| include: false
### Load libraries
library(raster)
library(rasterVis)
library(mapdata)
#library(maptools)
library(cmocean)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(latticeExtra)
library(grid)
library(rerddap)
library(terra)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
# Set report year (RptYr), to make things easier
RptYr <- 2024

# Set path to variable: Fisheries Indicators
# This is where the data are and where the plots will go
Dir <- here('Fronts')
```

```{r}
#| include: false

#Set working directory
setwd(Dir)
if (!dir.exists(file.path('STFfigs'))) { dir.create(file.path('STFfigs')) }
if (!dir.exists(file.path('TZCFfigs'))) { dir.create(file.path('TZCFfigs')) }

# Area for which to make the maps
lat1 <- 45
lat2 <- 5
lon1 <- 180
lon2 <- 240
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false

#----------------------------------------------------------
#   STF  
#----------------------------------------------------------
## Download data from erddap
# For temp we are using the Coral Reef Watch product https://oceanwatch.pifsc.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/CRW_sst_v3_1_monthly.html
# for ease I'm downloading one month at a time for all years, so first Jan then Feb and then March
sstInfo <- info(url = 'https://oceanwatch.pifsc.noaa.gov/erddap', datasetid = 'CRW_sst_v3_1_monthly')
monthIdx <- c(31,28,31)
# Comment below out if you have already downloaded and saved the .nc file
# Looping through to grab files for Jan, then Feb, then March
for (i in 1:3) {
  sstDat <- griddap(sstInfo, time = c(paste0('1985-0',i, '-', monthIdx[i],'T12:00:00Z'), paste0(RptYr, '-0',i,'-', monthIdx[i],'T12:00:00Z')), latitude = c(lat1, lat2), longitude = c(lon1, lon2),
                    fields = sstInfo$variables$variable_name[1],
                    stride = c(12,1,1),
                    store=disk(paste0(Dir,'/STFdata')))
}

```


```{r}
#| include: false

# Read in the files
STFfiles <- list.files(paste0(Dir,'/STFdata'), full.names = T)
# Read all three files into R and combine as stack and sort them after the date (name)
t1 <- brick(STFfiles[1])
t2 <- brick(STFfiles[2])
t3 <- brick(STFfiles[3])
# # Make a vector with the brick names
# flz <- c(t1, t2, t3)
# # Sort the bricks into monthly order. These are read in after alphabetical name, not which month it is, so fixing that here for when we need to read in the months in order
# fileIdx <- order(c(unique(month(t1@z$`Date/time`)), unique(month(t2@z$`Date/time`)), unique(month(t3@z$`Date/time`))))
# Make a climatology for all years except the most recent/current one
#tclim <- mean(stack(flz[[fileIdx[1]]], flz[[fileIdx[2]]], flz[fileIdx[[3]]]))
tclim <- mean(stack(t1, t2, t3))

## Make the plot
# Get land information and make it into a spatial object
land <- maps::map('world2', fill=TRUE, xlim=c(180,240), ylim=c(20,45), plot=FALSE)
#ids <- sapply(strsplit(land$names, ":"), function(x) x[1])
#bPols <- map2SpatialPolygons(land, IDs=ids, proj4string=CRS('+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs'))
bPols<- as_Spatial(st_as_sf(land))

# make map themes
mapThemeSST <- rasterTheme(region=rev(brewer.pal(11, 'Spectral')))
mapThemeChl <- rasterTheme(region=cmocean('algae')(50))

# make averaging index
idx <- 1:nlayers(t1)
# years for labels
yr <- substr(names(t1), 2, 5) #Ideally you grab this from the names in the file, to make sure 

# Isolate the Report Year for background SST and emphasized contourline and make a dataset
RptIdx <- which(yr==RptYr)
datRptYr <- mean(brick(t1[[RptIdx]],t2[[RptIdx]],t3[[RptIdx]]))
# Start your plot by making the report year background SST
p0 <- levelplot(datRptYr, pretty=T, margin=F, par.setting=mapThemeSST, at=seq(4,29.5,by=0.3)) + layer(sp.polygons(bPols, fill='gray50', col='gray30'))

# Loop through all years of the dataset to add gray contours for each year
# Add each contour to the plot initiated above
for (i in idx) {
  # Average Jan-Mar data for year i
  dat <- mean(brick(t1[[i]],t2[[i]],t3[[i]]))
  # Make ith year contour
  p1 <- contourplot(dat, pretty=T, margin=F, cuts=1, at=18, labels=F, lwd=0.5, par.settings = list(add.line = list(col = "gray")))
  # Add contour to plot
  p0 <- p0+p1
}
# Finally add the climatology contour as a dashed line and the report year contour as a solid black line
p0 <- p0 + contourplot(datRptYr, pretty=T, margin=F, cuts=1, at=18, labels=F) + contourplot(tclim, pretty=T, margin=F, cuts=1, at=18, labels=F, lty=2)

# Save plot
png(paste0(Dir, '/SAFE_STFmap_', RptYr, '.png'), width=7, height=5, res=300, units='in') 
p0
dev.off()

```
